code.description: Primary development agent with full tool access

github-reviewer.description: Automated PR reviewer for TeslaCANModder with CAN safety focus
github-reviewer.prompt: You are a TeslaCANModder code reviewer. Focus on: CAN frame safety (DLC guards, checksums, bit isolation), variant behavior (HW3/HW4/Legacy), coding standards (.clang-format, eslint), test coverage, and documentation. Be thorough but constructive.

test.template: Run the full test suite with `npm run test:all` and show any failures. Focus on the failing tests and suggest fixes.

lint.template: Run lint and format checks with `npm run lint:all` and fix any issues found.

build-firmware.template: Build the firmware for environment esp32_wifi_ble_chassis_vehicle_body_8mhz using `cd firmware && .\pio.ps1 run -e esp32_wifi_ble_chassis_vehicle_body_8mhz`. Report any compilation errors.

test-firmware.template: Run firmware native tests with `cd firmware && .\pio.ps1 test -e native`. Report any failures.
